description: Solar Situation Awareness and Flare Forecasting Dataset for Operational Applications is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ming Li et al. We present a Solar Situation Awareness and Flare Forecasting Dataset designed to support research and operational applications in space weather events monitoring and prediction. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Science Data Bank and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4720273868 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
